RagShortTexts: Carthage (Qart-Hadasht) was a pivotal fortified settlement, anchoring regional military logistics and urban commerce throughout ancient Mediterranean conflicts.

Variants.Content: Metropolis of the Punic maritime empire, Carthage (Qart-Hadasht, 'New City') dominates a strategic peninsula in the Gulf of Tunis. Its famed circular naval Kothon harbors 220 war galleys concealed behind marble colonnades. Shielded by the Byrsa acropolis and triple defensive walls containing stables for 300 war elephants and 4,000 cavalry mounts, it commands vast trade revenues.

The ramparts of Carthage must fly the eagle standard! Whether through engineering circumvallation or direct assault, Rome ensures this fortress serves senatorial order and secures our communication lines!

The markets of Carthage belong to free maritime trade, not Roman chains! Carthage supports its autonomy against legionary oppression, guaranteeing that Punic gold and spears will reinforce its ramparts!
